decision_order: This protocol is written before enumerating candidate pools, selecting anchors or executing measurement SQL. Schema inspection and inspection of the earlier frozen pilot inform its design. No fresh model response is part of this study.
purpose: Measure which explicit operator mistakes the released records can distinguish; build replayable source-bound witnesses for six analytical operations and one prespecified composition, while retaining every unavailable cell.
input_policy: Pin the five released SQLite databases to the original analytical-pilot source and database SHA256 values. Open mode=ro&immutable=1 with query_only=ON. Preserve the frozen pilot, all stored outputs, the manuscript and original databases. No database synthesis, data edits, service startup or paid API.
identity: A typed section is the complete (specification, release, clause) triple. Document and cohort membership use released identifiers. Disposition inclusion is evidence_status=source_verified and scope=whole_target. Distinct documents count once per code; several codes on one document contribute once to each group.

families.pack_disposition_counts: Count distinct documents by disposition code in an explicitly named cohort. Pack cohorts use cr_in_pack. Resolution-meeting cohorts use disposition joined to resolution on resolution_id and restricted to one meeting_id; only records from that meeting contribute. Separate cohort types remain explicit in every result.
families.shared_clauses: Return full typed section identities in the intersection of two member documents of one pack.
families.exclusive_clauses: Return full typed section identities in the directed difference first-document minus second-document, both members of one pack.
families.both_clause_documents: Return pack members with links to both of two distinct full typed section identities.
families.largest_clause_footprint: Return all pack members attaining the maximum count of distinct full typed section identities, and their counts; zero-link members remain in the comparison.
families.members_without_clause_records: Return pack members with zero recorded typed section links in this released snapshot.
families.conjunction_disposition_counts: Within one pack, first require links to both named typed sections; then count distinct qualifying documents by source-verified whole-document code. This prespecified composition combines conjunction and grouped aggregation, with an SQL CTE and a Python set-filter-then-group derivation.

requires: at least two output code groups
at least one grouped raw joined row count exceeds its distinct-document count
both pack_multicode and pack_duplicates
at least two output code groups
at least one grouped raw joined row count exceeds its distinct-document count
both meeting_multicode and meeting_duplicates
nonempty intersection, nonempty first-only set, nonempty second-only set
intersection requirements
matching on specification and clause while ignoring release admits a full typed first-document identity outside the true intersection
nonempty intersection, nonempty first-only set, nonempty second-only set; enumerate both directions
difference requirements
matching on specification and clause while ignoring release removes a true directed-difference identity
at least one both-link member, one first-only member and one second-only member
conjunction requirements
release-blind matching admits an additional member
at least two distinct positive footprint counts
maximum_variation requirements
at least two documents attain the maximum
maximum_variation requirements
collapsing release in distinct counts changes the complete (document,count) result set
maximum_variation requirements
collapsing release changes the maximum document identity set
maximum_ties and maximum_release_count requirements
at least one zero-link member and at least one positive-link member
conjunction requirements
nonempty grouped answer
using OR before aggregation changes the complete histogram

pool_enumeration: For each WG, enumerate every actual pack and resolution-meeting cohort. For pair operations enumerate all pairs of pack members sharing at least one typed identity, then apply the declared set witnesses. Difference enumerates both orientations. For conjunction and composition enumerate all distinct section pairs co-occurring in at least one member, then apply all declared set witnesses. Enumerate all packs for maximum and absence. Full eligible candidate identities and witness metrics are retained per cell as compressed JSONL, with counts and content hashes. Empty pools remain unavailable; no substitution or changed eligibility.
selection: One anchor per WG/stratum. Select the minimum SHA256 of canonical JSON [study name, WG, stratum id, complete candidate identity]; hash ties use canonical candidate identity. Selection uses only declared relation-set properties, before SQL results and without model outputs. Repeated anchors across strata remain recorded and the unique-anchor count is reported. Every planned cell is reported.
gold_and_execution: Derive gold using Python sets/dictionaries from raw relation rows. Execute a separately expressed reference SQL and every applicable mutation on the same unchanged DB with a 60-second cap. Store complete output sets, differences, timings, input/output and implementation hashes. A mutation is discriminating only after successful execution returns a different row set; SQL errors/timeouts are retained as execution outcomes and never counted as semantic discrimination. Execute references and mutants for every selected item. Preserve all disagreements and diagnose them without replacing the anchor.
independent_validation: Produce a portable input/output bundle enabling a checker that imports neither the builder nor its gold functions to reconstruct typed sets, all pool counts, selected anchors and reference/mutant outputs. A separate reviewer may perform this check after freeze. Report the performed check distinctly from the intended independent check.
analysis: Report WG/stratum availability, complete candidate counts, unique anchors, Python/reference agreement, successful mutant executions and exact output differences. Report code-group cardinality, duplicate row excess, set region sizes, tied winner counts, release-collapse count and winner changes, and composition stages. Interpret discrimination as sensitivity to these named mistakes on actual records, with no general query equivalence guarantee, human-demand estimate, broad model-difficulty claim or model-accuracy claim.
prior_work_scope: SemBench already organizes semantic-engine workloads across scenarios, modalities and operators. Bench-U already varies analytic operators, selectivity and composition using structured ground truth. Zhong, Yu and Klein's distilled SQL test suites already target semantic evaluation using multiple database instances; query mutation and distinguishing data are established evaluation ideas. This study applies explicit witness predicates and availability accounting to immutable released source-bound process records. Its contribution is the measured resource-specific semantic coverage and replayable evidence, rather than a new mutation-testing or SQL-equivalence method.
publication_gate: Fresh model responses require a separate root-coordinated blinded writer protocol. This stage freezes workload, gold, references and actual semantic-sensitivity measurements only. Public inclusion follows independent semantic validation and an explicit source-aligned interpretation. Existing pilot scores remain distinct.
